svg.title: Wallet signing, broadcast and the block explorer
svg.desc: Five steps: the wallet signs with a local private key; the signed transaction; an RPC node checks it and holds it in the mempool; a validator includes it in a block; the explorer shows network, status, from, to, logs, block and hash. Notes: the key never leaves the wallet; an unmined hash is not a fact.
